entities.name: Shinka
entities.description: Location in the Sokenzan mountains; in the books the cave-dwelling of Hidetsugu, on the cards a skull-lined citadel built by ogres.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: O-bakemono ogre shaman who lived in the cave Shinka, performed rituals and trained apprentices.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War a thousand years after which Shinka was built, per the cards.

entities.name: Sanzoku
entities.description: Mountain bandits who claimed Shinka's mortar was ground bones.

events.summary: Ogres build Shinka a thousand years before the Kami War as a monument to the oni they worship.
events.quote: The ogres built Shinka a thousand years before the Kami War

relations.quote: Shinka was a cave-dwelling of the o-bakemono Hidetsugu
